overview_description.description:
Operator of Circular Economy platform for electronics retailers and OEMs. Platform offers the ability for consumers to trade-in used devices and/or subscribe to new and used devices. The company provides an in-store portal for sales associates and an online checkout experience. The company’s software integrates all necessary partners including lenders, insurers, logistic providers, refurbishers, recyclers, etc. and provides a branded customer journey.

Founded in Stockholm in 2016, program partners include Apple, Elkjøp and Microsoft. US offers can be found at http://www.getupgraded.com
